siteSource: docs/LUNAR_ADDITIONAL_SITES_RESEARCH.md catalog row 9 (Faustini Rim A, LM7), NASA Lunar Surface Data Book M2M-30044 Table A2.1-1. PGDA/Data Book reference point; center of an original candidate-region polygon; not an approved landing site.

featureNotes.ridge: Highest source pixel within 250 m of the sampled skyline at grid bearing 155 degrees from the viewpoint: a crest of the highland grid-south-southeast of the site, about 4.4 km away and 412 m above the viewpoint, forming the far skyline of the initial view. Descriptive label from numeric LM7 elevation and illustrative hillshade; not an IAU feature name.
featureNotes.third: Off-grid holdout on terrain grid-west-northwest of the site, about 2.9 km away; no mission significance.
featureNotes.nearDetail: Gentlest 25 m window found within 45 m of the saved point (about 2.5 degree plane-fit slope versus 5.1 degrees at the point), about 40 m grid-south-southwest of it. The surroundings slope about 4 to 5 degrees, rising grid-southeast. Selected for scale-figure footing, not landing suitability.
featureNotes.crop: 12 x 12 km, shifted 1 km grid-east and 2 km grid-south of the saved point so that the highland skyline seen from the initial view (crests 3.3-6.1 km away and 280-480 m above the viewpoint) lies inside the crop. A planar raster scan across the view in 4-degree steps found every skyline point at least 2.9 km inside the crop boundary; a 24-bearing scan from the viewpoint found every skyline point at least 1.6 km inside it.
featureNotes.light: Illustrative Blender/QA light from grid bearing about 245 degrees at about 20 degrees elevation, so the view (grid bearing 155 degrees) is side-lit rather than backlit. Not an ephemeris Sun; the application lights terrain with its own Sun direction.

siteLimitations: The saved point lies on the rim region grid-southwest of Faustini crater; terrain falls toward grid-north and grid-northeast into the crater. The 12 x 12 km crop includes neither the Faustini floor nor its far rim, so looking grid-north shows the local rim break with no distant terrain behind it.
Terrain beyond the LM7 raster (more than about 10 km from the site) was not checked; a higher feature outside the raster could rise above the modeled skyline.
The astronaut stands on a gently sloping triangle selected for footing; no claim of walkability, safe footing or landing suitability.
